## State Desk editorial checklist — publisher approval required

- [ ] I personally checked the final body, headline, byline, timestamps and all important facts against the original links.
- [ ] The claim-to-citation record in `editorial/claims.json` is updated for each new or materially edited story.
- [ ] All direct quotes are real, short, correctly attributed, and not invented from AI or headline snippets.
- [ ] Sensitive allegations have direct evidence and context; contested claims receive independent corroboration and relevant responses.
- [ ] Race calls, vote snapshots, forecasts, certified totals, candidate positions and polling are individually and correctly distinguished.
- [ ] Photographs are verified at their original Wikimedia source pages with photographer and license attribution.
- [ ] New writing is original, not republished wire copy; AP attribution appears only for material genuinely sourced to AP.
- [ ] Site nav, article/analysis indexes, RSS, sitemap, corrections and older archives remain intact.
- [ ] Editorial checks and real Playwright phone/desktop screenshots pass and have been reviewed.
- [ ] The publisher, Gabriel Ervin, has explicitly approved this **draft** PR. Do not auto-merge or publish AI-generated stories.
